verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 9 285K is a desktop CPU, not a software agent or application, so acting as an MCP client that plugs in MCP servers is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships such a capability. Its AI framework support (OpenVINO, ONNX RT) and Copilot+ compatibility describe hardware acceleration and host-platform features, not an MCP client.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
